methodology_boundaries: Preserve source-defined measures and denominators by release; do not project a universal utilisation unit in Bronze.
Preserve unavailable comparisons and their source-stated reasons rather than treating missing comparison as negative evidence.
Preserve the 2012 variation approach separately from expected-versus-observed estimates.
Acquire only the corrected 2012 workbook and report version exposed by the official landing page, while recording the correction notice.
rights_boundary: NHS England content is generally released under the OGL, but the source pages declare IMS Health and pharmaceutical-company data. Acquire and retain privately; do not publish source files or derived records unless a later review proves an OGL-safe separable subset.
evidence_limit: Use measurements do not establish recommendation, approval, funding, effectiveness, or clinical appropriateness. The historic series is distinct from the successor Innovation Scorecard.
